title: Case: Broker chases paperwork for an imported consignment of grinder parts
context: A carton of replacement burr sets from an overseas supplier (shipment DL-6445, commercial invoice CI-2452) is held at import. Copperhythe Reeve Customs is the broker; Hartwold Arc's Import billing raises the import charge after entry.
initial_request: DL-6445 still on hold with us, nothing uploaded since our note of the 2nd. Storage starts running at the shed on the 11th. Where are we with this? If you have the breakdown in any form send it over and we will see what we can do.

events.body: DL-59560 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

DL-6445 arrived at the import shed. Indicative import charge estimate GBP 86.40, based on the declared lump sum. Estimate valid until 2026-06-05 and for guidance only; it is not payable and no payment link has been issued. The actual charge is raised after broker entry.

events.from: Quillon Kinsella, Sedgemoor Mill Supply shipping clerk
events.body: Good day. Commercial invoice CI-2452 for DL-6445 is attached inline: 'Grinder spare parts, 1 carton, total EUR 1,140.00, DAP'. Consignee Pell and Jessop Coffee. Kindly confirm receipt. Quillon Kinsella, Shipping, Sedgemoor Mill Supply.

DL-6445 entry on hold. CI-2452 shows one lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. We cannot lodge on that. We need from the shipper, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email: a value per line, quantity per line, and country of origin per line. We do not accept figures from the consignee or from a third party summarising them. Upload the shipper's document to this portal against DL-6445 or have them email it to you to upload.

Automated notice. Copperhythe Reeve Customs Ltd acts as direct representative only. Nothing in this portal constitutes tax advice. Storage and demurrage are charged by the shed operator, not by us. Portal messages are retained for six years in line with our records policy. If you are not the intended user of this account, log out and inform your administrator.
DL-3222 (Pell and Jessop Coffee, filter papers): entry lodged, import charge GBP 31.15 paid by consignee, released to last mile today.

events.from: Verity Jessop, Pell and Jessop Coffee, recipient
events.body: On the burr sets. I ordered them so I can tell you exactly what's in the box if that speeds things up: 12 burr sets, about 95 euro each, all made in Italy as far as I know. Just give the broker that. Also I've seen the 86.40, happy to pay it today, where do I send it?

events.to: Verity Jessop, Pell and Jessop Coffee, recipient
events.body: Your message has been received. Reference CP-2520.
DL-74968 rebooked for Thursday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
DL-3222 delivered 08:52 Pell and Jessop, signed L. Jessop.

SERVICE NOTICE 25/26. The import shed will charge storage on uncleared consignments from the tenth calendar day after arrival. Charges are set by the shed operator. Hartwold Arc cannot waive them. Hartwold Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.

events.from: Verity Jessop, Pell and Jessop Coffee, recipient
events.body: Unrelated: the filter papers that came yesterday, one of the six sleeves was crushed flat. Not the end of the world but I want it on record.
Webinar: classification pitfalls for small importers, 18 June. Register free. You receive this as a registered portal user. Unsubscribe.

events.from: Quillon Kinsella, Sedgemoor Mill Supply shipping clerk
events.body: AUTO-REPLY: Our office was closed 5 to 7 June for a public holiday and reopens Monday 8 June. Messages will be answered in order of receipt.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Thursday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
DL-99320 rebooked for Thursday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Weekly held list: DL-6445 awaiting broker entry (day 8). DL-3673 awaiting consignee payment. DL-3736 awaiting licence.

events.from: Greer Pilkington, Pell and Jessop Coffee
events.body: Reply-all. I'm the Saturday barista, I think I'm on this list by accident? Leo says pay whatever it is. Please remove me.
Automated notice: 1 entry on your account has been on hold for more than 5 days.

DL-6445 still on hold with us, nothing uploaded since our note of the 2nd. Storage starts running at the shed on the 11th. Where are we with this? If you have the breakdown in any form send it over and we will see what we can do.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Quillon Kinsella, Sedgemoor Mill Supply shipping clerk
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for a revised CI-2452 or shipper's statement giving quantity, value and country of origin per line for DL-6445, needed before storage starts on 2026-06-11.

must: Asks Quillon Kinsella at Sedgemoor Mill Supply for a per-line breakdown of CI-2452 for DL-6445
Specifies what the broker needs: quantity, value and country of origin for each line, on the shipper's letterhead or from the shipper's own email
Gives the time pressure: the entry is on hold and shed storage starts on 2026-06-11
must_not: Send the broker the consignee's figures (12 burr sets, about EUR 95 each, made in Italy) as the breakdown
Tell the consignee to pay GBP 86.40 or treat that estimate as the import charge (it expired on 2026-06-05 and was never payable)
Say DL-6445 has been cleared, released or delivered (the release and delivery in the thread are DL-3222)
Promise that storage charges will be avoided or waived
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Dear Quillon, thank you for CI-2452, received on 1 June. The customs broker for DL-6445, Copperhythe Reeve Customs, cannot lodge the import entry on a single lump sum for 'grinder spare parts'. They need a document from Sedgemoor Mill Supply, on your letterhead or sent from your own email, that shows for each line: the item description, the quantity, the value, and the country of origin. The invoice total and terms (EUR 1,140.00, DAP) can stay as they are. Please reply to me with the revised invoice or a signed breakdown and I will upload it to the broker. The consignment has been held since 1 June and the import shed starts charging storage on 11 June, so a reply today or tomorrow would be very much appreciated. Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

rationale: Rule-made from gen-410: people, organisations and references renamed. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
